Commit on the feature branch with a conventional message.

result.summary: Implemented ISS-0709 / GH #799 fix R1-R5 per src/design/vld-01-03-stage-16-validation-FIX.md. R1 freeSites now frees the []Site toOwnedSlice backing (site.zig); R2 typecheck test scaffolding converted to the owned-slice pattern (TypedEnv public contract unchanged); R3 mapDeclaredTypeName adds number/bool/timestamp + mod.zig UnknownVariableType message sync; R4a pd06 per-site gate moved to expr.parse (dangling operators 'amount >' now CEL_SYNTAX_INVALID); R4b mod.zig runs the PD-06 gate before any env finding (AC4 short-circuit literal); R5 mod.zig per-site loop frees the []Finding backing (transfer, not deep copy). Also fixed a pre-existing env-builder owned_node leak in mod.zig (addEntry re-dupes source_node_id). Verification: zig build exit 0; test-validation 38/38 (0 fail, 0 crash, 0 leaks); error-set check clean. The 14/14 and 5/5 integration gates are NOT met (9/14 vld-unit; vld-http red): remaining failures stem from defects OUTSIDE the R1-R5 scope (scope.zig absent-producer bailout, typecheck emitEmptyExpression source preservation, graph-level EDGE_MISSING_CONDITION vs EmptyExpression conflict, int_vld_02_01 fixture defect, vld-http 42P01 env/schema) - see issues.

verification.full_zig_build_test: run corpus 1105/1169 passed (64 skipped) = 0 fail / 0 crash; build step red from 3 PRE-EXISTING test-root compile errors (transition.zig:13, store.zig:12 'no module named graph') not caused by this fix

issues.description: test-integration-vld-unit 9/14 (not 14/14). All 5 remaining failures are outside R1-R5 scope: (1) int_vld_01_04 - scope.zig envForSite returns an EMPTY per-site env when any service_result/module_output producer node is absent from the graph, so global variable_schema entries become invisible (design §7 declares scope.zig out of scope); (2) int_vld_02_01 - test fixture defect: arithmetic ops (+ - * /) listed as 'positive' on a bool-expecting gateway guard so `a + b` legitimately yields TypeMismatch; (3) int_vld_02_05 - typecheck.zig emitEmptyExpression dups '' instead of preserving the whitespace source (spec VLD-03 AC2 requires preservation; design §3 R2 scopes typecheck.zig to test scaffolding only, so a behavior change is a documented deviation not taken); (4) int_vld_03_01/03_04 - graph.zig validateEdgeConditions CHK-EC-03 flags an EMPTY-string condition as EDGE_MISSING_CONDITION so the PD-06 gate fires (findings=0) instead of EmptyExpression+OperandTypeError+UnknownVariable (design §2.2/§7 declares graph.zig out of scope).

test-integration-vld-http not 5/5 (2/5 + 95 leaks). Handler-driven setup hits sqlstate 42P01 (undefined table) on process_definitions in the bpm_test DB tenant path (environment/schema provisioning), plus out-of-scope handler/test-harness code (src/api/routes/validation.zig is 'not changed' per design §7). Needs env/schema provisioning or a separate issue routed to TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-RUNNER.

Full `zig build test` build step is red from 3 PRE-EXISTING test-root compile errors unrelated to this fix: 'no module named graph available within module root' in src/engine/transition.zig:13 and src/definition/store.zig:12 (plus one more root). Among tests that run: 0 fail / 0 crash. These existed before this fix (pre-fix summary was 6 failed steps vs 3 now).

Documented in-scope-file deviation: also fixed a pre-existing owned_node memory leak in mod.zig env-builder (service_results/module_outputs/form_fields passed a caller-duped node_id to addEntry which re-dupes it, leaking the caller's copy on the success path). In the R5-touched module and required by the design's own 'zero leaked allocations' verification; cleared int_vld_01_03/01_05a/01_05b. Also adjusted the design's R5 pseudocode `try ... catch continue` to valid Zig (try and catch cannot be combined).
